name: founder-os-promptscript
description: PromptScript build tooling for Founder OS.

scripts.compile:promptscript: pnpm exec prs compile --build claude --force && pnpm exec prs compile --build codex --force && python3 scripts/sync_promptscript_outputs.py
scripts.compile:promptscript:all: pnpm exec prs compile --all-builds --force && python3 scripts/sync_promptscript_outputs.py
scripts.check:promptscript: pnpm exec prs validate --strict && pnpm exec prs compile --all-builds --force && python3 scripts/sync_promptscript_outputs.py --check && python3 scripts/generate_commands.py founder-os --check
